clips.title: The story
paras: Cork Gizelton and Rigger would normally lead their kodo past the Kolkar centaur village, yet they stop whenever the centaur war drums are heard. Cork asks you to protect the caravan past the Kolkar village, and payment is waiting with Smeed Scrabblescrew, a bit down the road.

Cork Gizelton and Rigger would normally take their kodo straight past the Kolkar centaur. Now and then the centaur war drums are heard, and the caravan stops, because dead traders make no profit. Cork asks you to guard the caravan past the Kolkar village, a short distance, and keep it in one piece. The caravan waits north of the Kolkar Village and southeast of Thunder Axe Fortress.
Payment waits with Smeed Scrabblescrew at Scrabblescrew's Camp, a bit down the road. Smeed does a little business with the Gizelton caravan.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Under normal circumstances, Rigger and I would lead our kodo past the Kolkar Centaur. Every now and then we hear the Centaur war drums, and when we hear those we stop. It's not good for business to be dead!
I'll tell you what adventurer, if you protect us past the Kolkar village we'll make it worth your while.
It's just a short distance, all you need to do is keep the caravan intact and you can pick up your reward from Smeed Scrabblescrew - he is down the road a bit. We do a little business together.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Why do I find myself waiting for that blasted caravan?
Oh yeah, they pay the bills. Have you seen them?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You know, it doesn't seem prosperous to be paying the likes of you to guard Gizelton Caravan. Adventurer, if I were a bit taller I could take on a second job and sit kodo-side-saddle with the biggest gun my hands could carry... And I'd show them blasted centaur who's their papa.
